fm-y-guardfunction
(defun fm-y-guard
  (y)
  (cond ((atom y) `((real/rationalp ,Y) (not (equal ,Y 0))))
    ((endp (cdr y)) `((real/rationalp ,(CAR Y)) (not (equal ,(CAR Y) 0))))
    (t (list* `(real/rationalp ,(CAR Y))
        `(not (equal ,(CAR Y) 0))
        (fm-y-guard (cdr y))))))
fm-x-guardfunction
(defun fm-x-guard
  (x)
  (cond ((atom x) `((real/rationalp ,X)))
    ((endp (cdr x)) `((real/rationalp ,(CAR X))))
    (t (cons `(real/rationalp ,(CAR X)) (fm-x-guard (cdr x))))))
fm-guardmacro
(defmacro fm-guard
  (x y)
  (cons 'and (append (fm-x-guard x) (fm-y-guard y))))

floor*function
(defun floor*
  (x y)
  (declare (xargs :measure (abs (floor x y))))
  (cond ((not (real/rationalp x)) t)
    ((not (real/rationalp y)) t)
    ((equal y 0) t)
    ((< y 0) (cond ((< 0 x) (1- (floor* (+ x y) y)))
        ((< y x) t)
        (t (1+ (floor* (- x y) y)))))
    (t (cond ((< x 0) (1- (floor* (+ x y) y)))
        ((< x y) t)
        (t (1+ (floor* (- x y) y)))))))
mod*function
(defun mod*
  (x y)
  (declare (xargs :measure (abs (floor x y))))
  (cond ((not (real/rationalp x)) t)
    ((not (real/rationalp y)) t)
    ((equal y 0) t)
    ((< y 0) (cond ((< 0 x) (mod* (+ x y) y))
        ((< y x) t)
        (t (mod* (- x y) y))))
    (t (cond ((< x 0) (mod* (+ x y) y))
        ((< x y) t)
        (t (mod* (- x y) y))))))
